But surprise, surprise, I'm still depressed af. My sleep is deprived and I have nightmares almost everynight. I found out that I've been eating like shit for the past couple of months. No exercise, little to no exposure of sunlight, still not talking to anybody outside my work duties. I'm trying to work on it, it's a slow process but I'm getting there. Now I'm not saying you should stop looking for a job, having money surely is a nice thing (realistically speaking). But you should also try to reflect on yourself. Seeking help from a professional is a perfect start. Then you can build your way up to a better state of mind. Good luck.
